With 103,021 miles and a broad smile on its grille, this Charger is priced competitively for buyers who want genuine American muscle without the new-car premium.About This 2019 Dodge Charger R/T The 2019 Charger R/T hits a sweet spot that fans of performance sedans know well — it's a four-door car that refuses to behave like one. At just over 103,000 miles, this example is well into its stride but far from done. The Charger's platform is engineered for long-term durability, and the HEMI V8 in particular is known to push well past 150,000 miles with proper maintenance. For buyers in Milwaukie and the greater Clackamas County area, this represents a rare opportunity to own a genuine muscle car at a used-vehicle value point. See the current price listed on this page.2019 Dodge Charger R/T Performance and Engine

The 5.7-Liter HEMI V8

The heart of this Charger R/T is Dodge's iconic 5.7-liter HEMI V8, producing 370 horsepower and 395 lb-ft of torque in stock form. This isn't a turbocharged four-cylinder pretending to be a performance engine — it's a naturally aspirated V8 with a deep, authoritative exhaust note that you feel in your chest at startup. Paired with the smooth 8-speed automatic transmission with AutoStick, the Charger delivers responsive gear changes whether you're cruising Highway 224 or merging onto I-205.

Rear-Wheel Drive Dynamics

Rear-wheel drive gives the R/T a classic, driver-focused character. Power is sent to the rear wheels for that traditional performance feel, and the Charger's wide stance and suspension tuning keep everything planted and composed. MDS (Multi-Displacement System) technology also allows the HEMI to deactivate four cylinders at highway speeds, improving fuel efficiency during everyday driving around Milwaukie and Clackamas County.Dodge Charger R/T Features and Interior The R/T trim level is where Dodge starts getting serious. Inside, you'll find a driver-oriented cockpit designed around the performance experience — sport-bolstered seating, an 8.4-inch Uconnect touchscreen (on 2019 models), Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, a performance Pages feature that displays real-time engine data, and keyless entry with push-button start. The Charger's cabin is genuinely spacious for a performance car, with rear-seat room that actually accommodates adults — a practical advantage no two-door muscle car can offer.

Safety tech on the 2019 R/T includes available blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-path detection, and a rearview camera. The reinforced structure and modern airbag system give this car solid passive safety credentials alongside its active performance capabilities.Dodge Charger Reliability and Ownership The 5.7-liter HEMI is one of the most proven V8 engines in modern American automotive history. It has powered everything from police interceptors to family haulers, and its simplicity — no turbochargers, no complex hybrid systems — means fewer failure points and lower repair costs when maintenance is needed. Charger R/T owners commonly report reaching 150,000 to 200,000 miles without major mechanical issues when routine maintenance is followed.

Common ownership notes for the 2019 Charger: keep up with spark plug intervals (the HEMI appreciates fresh plugs), use the recommended 5W-20 oil, and check the rear wheel bearings around high mileage intervals. The 8-speed automatic is generally reliable but benefits from periodic fluid changes. Overall, the Charger R/T has a strong reputation among enthusiasts as a durable, satisfying long-term ownership vehicle.Why Buy From Superstar Motorz in Milwaukie, Oregon Superstar Motorz is an independent dealership located in Milwaukie in Clackamas County, Oregon, known for offering performance vehicles and quality pre-owned inventory with a straightforward buying experience. Unlike high-volume franchise stores where you're just a number, Superstar Motorz brings a personal approach to every sale — helping buyers across the Portland metro area find the right vehicle without the runaround. Stock #4623 is available now, and the team is ready to walk you through every detail of this Charger before you commit.Financing a Used Dodge Charger Near Milwaukie Financing a pre-owned performance vehicle is easier than many buyers expect, and Superstar Motorz works with a range of lenders to find solutions that fit your situation. Whether you have strong established credit, are rebuilding after a rough patch, or are a first-time buyer exploring your options, the team can connect you with financing paths that work in the real world. Bring your questions, bring a trade-in if you have one, and let the team put together a package that makes this Charger work for your budget. No dollar figures to guess at — just see the current price on this page and start a conversation.Frequently Asked Questions

Is the 2019 Dodge Charger R/T a good buy?

Yes — the 2019 Charger R/T is widely regarded as one of the best values in the used muscle car market. The 5.7-liter HEMI V8, four-door practicality, modern Uconnect technology, and strong long-term reliability make it an appealing package for performance buyers who also need everyday usability.

How many miles is too many on a Dodge Charger R/T?

The HEMI V8 is famously durable. With documented maintenance history, a Charger R/T at 103,000 miles still has substantial life ahead. Many owners and fleet operators run these engines past 200,000 miles. A pre-purchase inspection is always smart, but mileage alone shouldn't be a dealbreaker on this platform.

What does the R/T trim include compared to base Charger models?

The R/T steps up from the SXT with the 5.7-liter HEMI V8 (versus the base V6), sport-tuned suspension, performance-oriented interior trim, and additional technology and safety features. It's the entry point into true Charger performance and a significant upgrade in driving experience.

Does the 2019 Charger R/T have good fuel economy?

For a V8 performance sedan, the R/T is reasonably efficient thanks to the HEMI's Multi-Displacement System, which cuts to four cylinders during light cruising. Real-world highway driving typically returns figures in the high teens to low 20s MPG, which is respectable for a naturally aspirated V8.

Is rear-wheel drive a problem in Oregon winters?

RWD does require more driver awareness in wet or snowy conditions. For Milwaukie and the Willamette Valley — where snow is rare but rain is plentiful — quality all-season tires and smooth inputs handle most winter conditions confidently. Clackamas County drivers who venture into the Cascades during winter months may want to consider a dedicated winter tire set.Serving Milwaukie and Surrounding Areas Superstar Motorz serves buyers throughout Milwaukie and the broader Clackamas County region, including neighbors from Lake Oswego, Oregon City, Gladstone, Happy Valley, Canby, and the surrounding Portland metro communities. With 109,000 miles on the odometer, this Accord is well into its middle life — but that's not a concern with this nameplate. Honda Accords routinely reach 200,000 miles and beyond with routine maintenance, meaning this car has a substantial amount of dependable driving still ahead of it. At this mileage and price point, it represents one of the stronger used car values you'll find in Stanislaus County right now.2019 Honda Accord Performance and EngineUnder the hood, this Accord LX is powered by Honda's 1.5-liter turbocharged inline four-cylinder engine with I-VTEC technology. Don't let the displacement fool you — this engine produces a strong, responsive power output that feels noticeably more spirited than naturally aspirated engines of the same size. Paired with a CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) equipped with a Sport Mode, daily commutes on Highway 99 or longer drives across the San Joaquin Valley feel effortless and controlled.

The front-wheel-drive layout keeps things predictable and easy to manage in everyday conditions, and the CVT's Sport Mode gives you a more engaged driving experience when you want it. Fuel economy is a genuine highlight — this engine is rated among the more efficient options in the mid-size sedan class, making it a smart choice for Modesto drivers who put in serious daily miles.Honda Accord LX Features and InteriorThe LX trim is Honda's entry-level Accord configuration, but don't mistake entry-level for bare bones. The 2019 Accord LX comes standard with Honda Sensing — the automaker's comprehensive suite of safety and driver-assistance technology — which includes Collision Mitigation Braking, Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, and Road Departure Mitigation.

Inside, the cabin is where the 10th-gen Accord truly shines. Honda completely rethought the interior with this generation, delivering a wide, airy environment with rear passenger space that rivals many larger vehicles. You get a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment display, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, Bluetooth connectivity, a rearview camera, and dual-zone automatic climate control. The LX also includes keyless entry and a Honda's well-regarded audio system. This is a genuinely comfortable sedan for families, commuters, and rideshare drivers alike.Honda Accord Reliability and OwnershipThe 2019 Honda Accord consistently earns top marks from both owners and industry analysts. J.D. Power gave the 10th-generation Accord high reliability scores, and Consumer Reports has ranked it among the most dependable mid-size sedans in recent years. The 1.5T engine, while occasionally noted in early production years for oil dilution in cold climates, performs well in California's warmer Central Valley conditions — a point worth noting for Modesto-area buyers specifically.

Maintenance costs for the Accord are among the lowest in its segment. Parts are widely available and affordable, and virtually every independent mechanic in Stanislaus County is familiar with servicing Honda vehicles. Absolutely. The 2019 Accord is part of Honda's critically acclaimed 10th generation, which was praised for its driving dynamics, interior space, safety technology, and long-term reliability. It remains one of the most recommended used mid-size sedans on the market today.

Not at all. Honda Accords are known for exceptional longevity, with many examples reaching 200,000 to 250,000 miles with basic maintenance. At 109,000 miles, this Accord still has a long, dependable service life ahead — especially in California's mild climate.

Is the CVT reliable in the 2019 Honda Accord?

Yes. Honda's CVT in the Accord has a strong track record for reliability and smoothness. The addition of Sport Mode addresses the traditional CVT complaint of feeling disconnected — it delivers a more responsive, engaging drive when you want it.Serving Modesto and Surrounding AreasPrestige Auto Sales - Modesto proudly serves buyers throughout Stanislaus County and the broader Central Valley. Experience the thrill of driving with this 2019 Subaru WRX Base sedan, finished in striking Crystal Black Silica. With just over 75,800 miles, this used vehicle offers a perfect balance of performance and practicality. Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine delivering 268 horsepower at 5600 rpm and 258 lb-ft of torque at 2000 rpm, it promises spirited acceleration and confident highway cruising. The 6-speed manual transmission and all-wheel drive system ensure an engaging drive, whether navigating city streets or tackling winding roads. Inside, the Carbon Black Checkered interior complements the sleek exterior, providing comfort and style for up to five passengers. Modern connectivity features include Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and satellite radio readiness, complemented by a backup camera for added safety.

This Subaru WRX is equipped with advanced safety features to give drivers peace of mind. It includes driver knee airbags and four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) to enhance stability and protection. Power door locks with anti-lockout functionality prevent accidental lock-ins, while cornering brake control improves handling during tight turns and emergency stops. These features combine to create a secure and confident driving experience, making it an ideal choice for enthusiasts who value safety as much as performance.

2019 Subaru WRX Safety and Security Features

This model prioritizes safety with driver knee airbags and four-wheel ABS, providing essential protection in various driving conditions. Anti-lockout power door locks prevent accidental lock-ins, and cornering brake control enhances stability during sharp turns, ensuring safety on every journey.

2019 Subaru WRX Entertainment and Technology Features

Stay connected and entertained with the Subaru WRX’s array of tech features. It offers smart device app compatibility through MySubaru, HD radio, and access to internet radio apps like Pandora, iHeartRadio, Stitcher, and AHA. The touch screen display controls the radio system, complemented by electronic messaging assistance with read and voice-operated functions. Six speakers deliver clear sound, enriching every drive with quality audio.

2019 Subaru WRX Performance Features

The WRX boasts a sport-tuned suspension, designed to enhance handling and cornering agility. Its full-time four-wheel drive system provides superior traction and stability, making it a reliable performer on various terrains and weather conditions. Together, these features deliver an exhilarating yet confident driving experience that’s characteristic of Subaru’s rally-inspired heritage.
